name: com.splattervault.sdk
description: Official Unity SDK for the SplatterVault game session management API. Create, manage, and monitor dedicated game servers programmatically. Includes Master Server Toolkit integration.

samples.description: Server-side session management: SimpleSessionManager and TournamentManager (Editor and dedicated server builds only; API key from an environment variable)
Server-side spawner for a Master Server Toolkit master server: starts or claims SplatterVault servers that register their own rooms (Editor and dedicated server builds only)
